_doc: Encounter templates: a named group of enemies a story scene calls in one line, *gosub_scene combat fight_<id>.
Edit here, then run: node tools/gen_encounters.js   (writes the fight_<id> labels into combat.txt and the dev hub menu).
Template fields:
id        the label is fight_<id>; lower case, digits and _ only
title     the dev hub's menu line
notes     a comment written above the label
morale    true (default): enemies can break, flee and surrender; false: they fight to the end (combat_no_morale)
nonlethal true: the whole fight is non-lethal (enemies are knocked out, humanoids surrender when broken)
no_flee   true: the player cannot run from it
leader    a slot number: the fight ends the moment that enemy falls
nonlethal_slot  a slot number: only that enemy's defeat is non-lethal
enemies   a list; each entry fills one or more slots, in order (6 at most in all):
type     an enemy type from tools/enemy_catalog.json (required)
name     the display name (default the type's name); with count > 1 each gets a number: Boar 1, Boar 2
epithet  how prose names it (default 'the ' + the name in lower case); with count > 1: the first boar, the second boar
group    what the story counts it as after the fight (default the name): count_results "Boar" "down"
count    how many (default 1)
hp, ac, atk, resolve   override the type's own numbers
range    the tier it opens at (0 Engaged, 1 Close, 2 Mid-Range, 3 Long Range); one number, or one per enemy
The caller still decides combat_player_can_die and the allies, as for any fight.

encounters.title: 🐗 Boar Pack -- 3 wild boars (template, morale on: they can run)
encounters.notes: Three wild boars rooting at the edge of a wood. Skittish beasts: hurt one badly or drop two and the rest may bolt.

encounters.notes: Two grey wolves that circle in from Close range.

encounters.notes: A bandit chief with a cutthroat at his side and an archer hanging back. Cut the chief down and the rest give it up.
